blind.description: A stylized, dome-shaped green bush covered with molded red roses. The foliage has a lumpy, clustered surface with varied shades of green, while the red blossoms are modeled with petal details and fused directly onto the bush exterior. The entire model is solid, contiguous, and rests directly on the ground without a pot or plinth.
blind.from_above: A rounded circular mound of green leafy clusters dotted evenly with red circular rose flowers.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 3.5 to 4 feet tall (roughly 60% the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3 feet wide.
